scripts.dev: rm -rf packages/shared/dist && bash scripts/ensure-postgres-running.sh && concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:forge: concurrently -n forge,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/forge" "npm run dev -w packages/forge-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend && npm run build -w packages/forge && npm run build -w packages/forge-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared --if-present && npm run test -w packages/backend --if-present && npm run test -w packages/frontend --if-present && npm run test -w packages/electron --if-present && npm run test -w packages/forge --if-present && npm run test -w packages/forge-web --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w packages/shared --if-present && npm run test:coverage -w packages/backend --if-present && npm run test:coverage -w packages/frontend --if-present && npm run test:coverage -w packages/electron --if-present
scripts.verify:merge-gates: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.lint:ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && node packages/electron/scripts/prepare-desktop-resources.js && npm run build -w packages/electron
scripts.build:desktop:win: npm run build && npm run build:win -w packages/electron
scripts.build:desktop:win:arm64: npm run build && npm run build:win:arm64 -w packages/electron
scripts.start:desktop: bash scripts/check-linux-desktop-prereqs.sh && bash scripts/fix-macos-electron-dev.sh && npm run build && node packages/electron/scripts/prepare-desktop-resources.js && npm run start -w packages/electron
